results.name: Foundation Consumer Healthcare Appoints Rupa Bahri As CEO, Refocuses On Women's Health » Her Forward
results.content:
Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH) has appointed Rupa Bahri as its new chief executive officer, marking a significant strategic transformation for the company. This leadership change follows FCH’s successful divestiture of its over-the-counter (OTC) wellness brands in June 2026. The move establishes FCH as a dedicated leader focused entirely on the women’s health sector.  
Bahri’s appointment culminates FCH’s efforts to streamline its portfolio and sharpen its focus on the high-growth women’s health market. She expressed honor in joining FCH at a “transformative time,” recognizing the opportunity to build an exceptional platform around its iconic brand, Plan B. The company views women’s health as a dynamic and crucial area within healthcare.  
Greg Bradley, who co-founded FCH and served as CEO since 2014, will transition to chairman of the board. During his 12-year tenure, Bradley scaled FCH from a startup to a top-10 OTC healthcare company, overseeing its recent strategic portfolio optimization.
## Leadership Transition and Future Vision  
The transition of leadership signifies FCH’s commitment to its new direction. Bradley’s move to chairman of the board will allow him to continue contributing to the company’s strategic oversight. He also serves as Chairman of the Board of the Consumer Healthcare Products Association (CHPA).  
Bahri’s vision for FCH involves leveraging its existing iconic brand, Plan B, to create a robust platform in women’s health. This strategic appointment positions FCH to capitalize on what it identifies as one of the most dynamic opportunities in healthcare today. This also aligns with a growing trend of [women executives](https://herforward.com/sheknows-platform-and-chief-awards-mark-shift-in-senior-women-executive-development/) taking on senior roles. Her appointment is a notable example of a [woman in healthcare leadership](https://herforward.com/four-rwjbarnabas-women-executives-named-to-beckers-2026-hospital-leader-list/).  
The appointment of Rupa Bahri as CEO, combined with the company’s refined focus, signals a dedicated approach to innovation and market leadership in the women’s health sector, as reported by [Morningstar](https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20260804da18485/foundation-consumer-healthcare-announces-senior-leadership-changes-following-strategic-repositioning-into-womens-health) and [AOL](https://www.aol.com/articles/foundation-consumer-healthcare-announces-senior-130500000.html).
## Frequently asked questions  
- ### Who is the new CEO of Foundation Consumer Healthcare?  
Rupa Bahri has been appointed as the new chief executive officer of Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH). Her appointment was announced on August 4, 2026.
- ### What is Foundation Consumer Healthcare's new strategic focus?  
Foundation Consumer Healthcare has undergone a strategic transformation to become a pure-play leader dedicated to the women’s health sector. This follows the divestiture of its OTC wellness brands.
- ### What is Greg Bradley's new role at FCH?  
Greg Bradley, who co-founded and led FCH as CEO since 2014, will now serve as chairman of the board for Foundation Consumer Healthcare.
- ### What experience does Rupa Bahri bring to her new role?  
Rupa Bahri has over two decades of global healthcare leadership experience, including serving as Canadian president of Haleon and holding leadership positions at Novartis Consumer and GSK Consumer Healthcare.
- ### When did Foundation Consumer Healthcare divest its wellness brands?  
Foundation Consumer Healthcare completed the targeted divestiture of its over-the-counter wellness brands to Prestige Consumer Healthcare in June 2026.
